name: The spared whelp
description: a brimstone whelp, a young demon of the Cracked Road the size of a dog, on four stubby clawed legs: cracked black basalt hide with thin orange glowing seams, two stubby charred horns, a big jaw glowing like a furnace, a short rock tail, small and scared, with big glowing pleading eyes

poses.stand: crouched small on its four stubby legs, looking up with big pleading eyes
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: trembles and squeaks, looking up with big eyes, tail tucked

hurt.action: flinches and whimpers, then looks up again

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
